title: Add Export to PDF functionality to Pioneers, Tasks, and Notes pages

requirements.text: Update the existing `frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts` utility to generate a downloadable PDF file (downloaded as 'pioneers-report.pdf') instead of opening a print window. The PDF must include: a header with 'Theiarco' app name, 'Pioneers Report' title, and the current date; a professional table with columns for Name, Service Year, Total Hours, Average Hours, Current Status, and Monthly Hours; header/accent colors using #43587A; black text on white background; landscape orientation for the wide table.

quotes: Include a header with the app name 'Theiarco' and the report title
Include the current date in the header
Use the app's primary color #43587A for headers/accents
Black text on white background for the content
Make it print-friendly
Download files as: 'pioneers-report.pdf'

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Export to PDF' on the Pioneers page downloads a file named 'pioneers-report.pdf'
PDF header contains 'Theiarco', 'Pioneers Report', and the current date formatted as a readable string
Table headers and accent elements use #43587A as background color with white or contrasting text
Table rows use black text on white background
All pioneer data visible in the Pioneers table is included in the PDF (name, service year, total hours, average hours, status, monthly hours)

requirements.text: On the existing `frontend/src/pages/Pioneers.tsx` page, ensure there is an 'Export to PDF' button positioned in the top-right action area next to the existing 'Export to CSV' and 'Add Pioneer' buttons. The button must call the updated `exportPioneersToPdf` utility passing the currently loaded pioneer data. Style the button to visually match the existing export buttons on the page. Do not alter any other part of the Pioneers page.

requirements.text: Implement the actual file download mechanism in the three PDF export utilities (`pioneersPdfExport.ts`, `tasksPdfExport.ts`, `notesPdfExport.ts`). Use the browser's print-to-PDF approach via a hidden iframe or a new window with `window.print()`, OR use a client-side PDF library (such as jsPDF with jsPDF-AutoTable) to programmatically generate a Blob and trigger a browser download via a temporary anchor element (`<a download='filename.pdf'>`). The chosen approach must result in the file being saved with the correct filename without requiring the user to manually rename it from a print dialog.

quotes: Use a PDF generation library (like jsPDF or similar) to create professional-looking PDFs
Download files as: 'pioneers-report.pdf', 'tasks-report.pdf', 'notes-report.pdf'

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking any Export to PDF button initiates a file download with the correct filename
The downloaded file is a valid PDF that can be opened
No manual rename step is required from the user
The PDF renders the header and table content correctly when opened

constraints: Do NOT modify or recreate any existing pages beyond adding the Export to PDF button and wiring it to the export utility
Do NOT modify the backend in any way
Do NOT change any existing CSV export functionality
Do NOT modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
Preserve all existing UI layout, filters, modals, and functionality on Pioneers, Tasks, and Notes pages
nonGoals: Rebuilding or recreating any existing pages from scratch
Adding PDF export to any pages other than Pioneers, Tasks, and Notes
Changing the backend data model or API
Adding new data fields that are not already present in the existing pages
